failure_summary.description: Passed a one-item rating list even though the filter requires a two-endpoint range.
Refined the base restaurant results instead of the cached results that already included the neighborhood constraint, then resent that constraint.
Did not bind and save the filtered result under a new cache key.

patch.reasoning: The cache-selection and persistence failures are already covered by existing skill instructions, so they do not need duplicative edits. The uncovered gap is explicit handling of range-valued arguments when the user supplies only one bound.

edits.target: ## Validate tool arguments and preserve user intent
edits.content: - For range-valued list arguments, satisfy the schema’s required number and order of endpoints. If the user gives a one-sided threshold (for example, “at least X”) for a field requiring a minimum and maximum, use X as the relevant endpoint and the known supported bound for the other endpoint; do not pass a singleton list or invent a bound that cannot be determined.
